frontmatter.name: credential-verifier
frontmatter.description: Request and verify digital credentials (such as ISO mdoc mobile driver's licenses and SD-JWT credentials) from a holder wallet in an Android app or WebView using Jetpack Credential Manager. Use this skill when building a digital credential verifier app in an Android project, constructing OpenID4VP (openid4vp-v1-unsigned) and Digital Credential Query Language (dcql_query) requests, calling CredentialManager.getCredential with GetDigitalCredentialOption, requesting multiple credentials simultaneously, or

nodes.label: Post-implementation warnings for the human developer
